title: Dengue cases in Agusan del Sur breach 4,000; deaths now 22

blocks.text: PROSPERIDAD, Agusan del Sur— Health authorities have raised the alarm anew as dengue infections in Agusan del Sur province continue to surge, breaching 4,000 cases and claiming 22 lives. Data from the Provincial Health Office (PHO) showed a cumulative total of 4,021 cases as of Nov. 16, with 248 new infections in the latest morbidity week.
